chose: Third-party images (redis, nats, prometheus, grafana, cadvisor, the exporters, metabase, redisinsight, ollama) are in the release, pinned repo:<real tag>@sha256, and refreshed by their own release PR monthly or on dispatch, never with an app publish. caddy runs at NixOS level and stays out.
options: pin them in the release, refreshed on their own cadence
pin them in the release, refreshed with every publish
gray: Proposed by Claude in the design; the owner did not object. A month is a guess at the cost of reviewing third-party moves against the risk of a stale CVE fix, and no convention covers it.
undo: Change the release-lock schedule, or drop the third-party services from the release and the guard.
